text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I just can't keep still with my debut race so close! I decide to go to the dojo to let off some steam and wouldn't you know it, I run right into my classmate, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno shares her super cool dream with me. She wants her grandparents to see her race formidable opponents to pay them back for looking out for her!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We both promise to race each other one day. I'll be Yaeno's formidable opponent and she'll be my ultimate rival!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH! I'm SOOO pumped up right now! I'm ready to go, go, GO!
